==Translingual==

===Etymology===
From {{af|mul|u-<t:micro->|s<id:Q11574><t:second>}}.

{{mul-symbol}}

# {{senseid|mul|Q842015}} {{lb|mul|metrology|informal|proscribed}} {{alt form of|mul|μs<id:Q842015>}}.

==English==
{{wikipedia}}

===Etymology 1===
{{etymon|en|id=pronoun|:inh|enm:us<id:pronoun>|tree=1}}
From {{inh|en|enm|us}}, from {{inh|en|ang|ūs||pos=dative personal pronoun|us}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*uns}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*uns||us}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro||*n̥swé}}, alteration of {{m|ine-pro|*n̥smé||us}}. The compensatory lengthening was lost in Middle English due to the word being unstressed when used. Cognate with {{cog|stq|uus|t=us}}, {{cog|fy|us}}, {{m|fy|us|ús|us}}, {{cog|nds|uns}}, {{m|nds|us||us}}, {{cog|nl|ons||us}}, {{cog|de|uns||us}}, {{cog|da|os||us}}, {{cog|la|nōs||we, us}}.

====Pronunciation====
* {{a|en|GA}}
** {{IPA|en|/əs/|a=weak form}}
** {{IPA|en|/ʌs/|a=strong form}}, {{enPR|ŭs}}
* {{a|en|RP}}
** {{IPA|en|/əs/|/əz/|a=weak form}}
** {{IPA|en|/ʌs/|a=strong form}}, {{enPR|ŭs}}
* {{a|en|Northern England,Local Dublin}}
** {{IPA|en|/ʊz/|a=strong form}}, {{enPR|ŭs}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɪz/|a=Northumbrian}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-us.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ʌs|s=1}}

====Pronoun====
{{en-pron|personal pronoun; the objective case of '''[[we]]'''}}

# [[me|Me]] and at least one other person, excluding the person(s) being addressed. {{qualifier|[[exclusive]] ''us''.}}
#: {{ux|en|Don't treat '''us''' like idiots.}}
# [[me|Me]] and at least one other person, including the person(s) being addressed. {{qualifier|[[inclusive]] ''us''.}}
#: {{ux|en|Let's ask him if he'll give '''us''' a lift.}}
#* {{RQ:KJV|Luke|1|1|text=Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among '''us'''...}}
# [[we|We]], {{non-gloss|used in the same circumstances where "me" would be used instead of "I", e.g. for the pronoun in isolation or as the complement of the copula:}}
#: {{ux|en|Who's there? &mdash; '''Us'''. (or) &mdash; It's '''us'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|Who's going to go? &mdash; '''Us'''. We'll go.}}
# Any entity that the speaker is a part of or identifies with, such as place of employment or education, [[nation]], [[region]], [[language]], etc.
#: {{ux|en|It's not true that the rest of Europe hates '''us'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|I went to watch my favourite team play Real Madrid, but they thrashed '''us''' 5-0.}}
# People in general.
#: {{ux|en|Grief ages '''us'''.}}
# {{lb|en|colloquial}} The person(s) being addressed.
#: {{ux|en|Come on! Wakey wakey! Let's get '''us''' up and out of bed, please.}}
# {{lb|en|colloquial}} {{n-g|Used to imply connection between the speaker's experiences or activities and a group of listeners}}.
#: {{ux|en|Hey guys, in this video I'll show you how I make my upside-down sponge cake. First let's get '''us''' a few ingredients that we'll need ...}}
# {{lb|en|Commonwealth|colloquial|chiefly with certain verbs such as {{m|en|give}}, {{m|en|get}}, {{m|en|fetch}}, etc.}} [[me|Me]].
#: {{ux|en|Give '''us''' a look at your paper.}}
#: {{ux|en|Fetch '''us''' a cold beer from the fridge, would you.}}
#: {{ux|en|She's turned the [[weans]] against '''us'''!}}
#: {{ux|en|''(talking to oneself)'' Now then ... let me see ... I hope I'm doing this right ... if we just connect these two wires together ... if it gives '''us''' a shock then ... Ow!}}
# {{lb|en|Northumbria}} Me (in all contexts).
#: {{ux|en|Look at '''us''' while ye’re speakin tiv '''us'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|Could ye dee that for '''us'''?}}

|passage=He steiht ferm wie en Zeller '''us''' dem Hamm.|t=He stands firm as a Zell man '''from''' the ''Hamm'' [i.e. the Moselle bow around Zell with its steeply sloped vineyards].}}

=====Usage notes=====
* Where it occurs in Moselle Franconian, it generally does so only in unstressed position while the stressed form is {{m|gmw-cfr|aus}}, {{m|gmw-cfr|ous}}.
